about.h2: The Taste of Southern India, Served at Your Event
about.p1: Best of India is your destination for authentic South Indian cuisine in Paris. We specialise in Chettinad cuisine, one of the richest and most refined culinary traditions of South India. Originating in Tamil Nadu, it is known for its character, its intense spices and its balance of boldness and subtlety.
about.p2: Every dish is prepared according to traditional recipes, with a unique blend of freshly ground spices such as black pepper, fennel, cinnamon and curry leaves. We select our ingredients carefully to guarantee freshness, quality and respect for Indian culinary traditions.
about.p3: Our catering service brings this same care to your celebration. Tell us about your event, your guests and your budget, and we will help you build the right menu.
